assertionSteps.title: 1. Given USER-A has Home visible at 320 by 568 CSS pixels
2. When USER-A clicks the section labelled "New Tile" on the Home page
3. Then The section labelled "Tile Options" on the Home page is visible within the viewport or its scroll area
4. When USER-A presses "Escape" inside the section labelled "Tile Options" on the Home page
5. Then The section labelled "Tile Options" on the Home page is hidden
6. When USER-A clicks the icon button with test ID "${MFE_APP_PREFIX_STYLE}_avatar_IconButton" on the Home page
